title: CVE-2026-124017 — Phison E12 and E18 PCIe SSD controllers contain a Secure Boot bypass vulnerability that allows a privileged local attacker to inject persistent boot-p
summary: Phison E12 and E18 PCIe SSD controllers contain a Secure Boot bypass vulnerability that allows a privileged local attacker to inject persistent boot-patch tuples into the unsigned, CRC-protected flash ID page read by the BootROM. By overwriting a fuse-derived RAM variable via a crafted patch entry using Phison Vendor Specific Commands, an attacker can force CRC-only firmware verification instead of signature checking, enabling an unsigned firmware image to load and creating a persistent controller-level implant that survives firmware reinstallation and operates below the host operating system.

summary:
Improper restriction of intended endpoints in the connection configuration handling of the AWS Labs Timestream for InfluxDB MCP Server (awslabs.timestream-for-influxdb-mcp-server) before 0.0.19 might allow a remote unauthenticated actor (via prompt injection) to obtain the InfluxDB API token configured on the server, sent to a crafted endpoint controlled through an InfluxDB URL introduced in the MCP client context.



To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 0.0.19 or later and rotate any InfluxDB API tokens configured for the server.

title: CVE-2026-57150 — GLPI is a free asset and IT management software package
summary: GLPI is a free asset and IT management software package. Prior to 10.0.28, 11.0.10, and 12.0.1, authenticated users can craft a URL that invokes massive actions without all required object- and action-specific authorization checks. The bypass permits operations outside the user's granted rights, including unauthorized plugin activation, deactivation, and uninstallation for plugins already present on the filesystem and other state-changing maintenance actions. This issue is fixed in versions 10.0.28, 11.0.10, and 12.0.1.

title: CVE-2026-57151 — GLPI is a free asset and IT management software package
summary: GLPI is a free asset and IT management software package. From 11.0.0 until 11.0.10 and 12.0.1, an authenticated technician can modify the two-factor authentication security of a user with higher privileges because the affected operations do not enforce all required authorization checks for the target user. This allows the technician to disable or take control of the higher-privileged user's two-factor authentication protection. This issue is fixed in versions 11.0.10 and 12.0.1.

summary: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260624.0, an Organization Administrator with VIRTUAL_ORGANIZATION_ADMIN and KNOWLEDGE_KNUPDATE can use organizationFieldPatch to replace the administered organization's grantable_groups without a SETTINGS_SETACCESSES authorization check. The administrator can add the built-in Administrators group to that grant scope and then bypass the grantable_groups guard added by the incomplete CVE-2026-44730 remediation to add their own account to Administrators. title: CVE-2026-71306 — Mikochi is a minimalist file manager with streaming capabilities
summary: Mikochi is a minimalist file manager with streaming capabilities. Prior to 1.10.1, authenticated users of bare-metal instances configured with a non-default trailing-slash DATA_DIR can use the Move endpoint to supply traversal-containing source or destination paths. The affected path validation can resolve those paths outside the configured data directory, allowing files to be written beyond Mikochi's intended storage boundary. Docker deployments that confine the data directory to a mounted volume and configurations whose DATA_DIR lacks a trailing slash are not affected by the described attack

title: CVE-2026-76822 — OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables
summary: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260701.0, the caseIncidentAdd, caseRfiAdd, and caseRftAdd GraphQL mutations require only authentication and do not require a capability check. An authenticated user with reader-level permissions can therefore create incident, request-for-information, and request-for-takedown case objects regardless of the user's assigned role, causing unauthorized changes to platform data. This issue is fixed in version 7.260701.0.

title: CVE-2026-76823 — OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables
summary: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260706.0, the logsWorkerConfig GraphQL query is authorized with the broad CONNECTORAPI capability and returns Elasticsearch connection details including elasticsearch_username, elasticsearch_password, elasticsearch_api_key, the URL, index, proxy, and TLS-verification setting. title: CVE-2026-77597 — iSponsorBlockTV is a SponsorBlock client for YouTube TV clients
summary: iSponsorBlockTV is a SponsorBlock client for YouTube TV clients. Prior to 2.11.0, src/iSponsorBlockTV/dial_client.py trusts the SSDP LOCATION URL supplied by a local-network responder without validating its destination. During automatic discovery, this can cause an attacker-directed GET request and a constrained POST request to a path ending in /YouTube; the POST uses application-defined headers and an application-defined payload rather than attacker-selected request contents. title: CVE-2025-71471 — GPAC before 26
summary: GPAC before 26.02.0 contains a use of uninitialized memory vulnerability in stbl_AddCTS() that allows attackers to corrupt sample table data via crafted MP4 files. Attackers can supply an MP4 with out-of-order composition time offsets for MP4Box import, triggering invalid memory access in gf_list_get() and crashing the process.

title: CVE-2026-110339 — The Libreswan pluto daemon dereferences a NULL pointer when a CERT payload is received with an empty PKCS#7 payload, causing the daemon to crash and r
summary: The Libreswan pluto daemon dereferences a NULL pointer when a CERT payload is received with an empty PKCS#7 payload, causing the daemon to crash and restart. The NSS function SEC_PKCS7GetCertificateList() was used to check whether the content was empty, but this check did not trigger if the non-empty content of the PKCS#7 wrapped payload was an empty list. Continued triggering of this vulnerability can lead to a denial of service. Remote code execution is not possible. Authentication is not required to trigger this vulnerability.

summary: The Libreswan IKEv2 state machine did not verify that an IKE_INTERMEDIATE exchange was required to satisfy the addke= PostQuantum algorithm component of the exchange. A connecting client could (maliciously or by implementation error) skip the IKE_INTERMEDIATE exchange and start an IKE_AUTH exchange prematurely. The result is as if the addke= option had not been specified, and such connections are only protected by the classic key exchange algorithm (such as P-256 or Curve25519), allowing "store now, decrypt later" attacks once a quantum computer becomes available. title: CVE-2026-120697 — Wiki
summary: Wiki.js is an open source wiki app built on Node.js. title: CVE-2026-120698 — Wiki
summary: Wiki.js is an open source wiki app built on Node.js. Prior to 2.5.315, an authenticated account with only manage:users can use users.update to change the password of any local account, including the Root administrator and other accounts with manage:system, by omitting the optional groups argument, which is automatically allowed and bypasses destination-group authorization without checking the target's current privileges. The attacker can use users.disableTFA to clear the same target's tfaIsActive state and TFA secret without a target-privilege check, then authenticate with the replacement pass

title: CVE-2026-123353 — Docmost is open-source collaborative wiki and documentation software
summary: Docmost is open-source collaborative wiki and documentation software. Prior to 0.96.0, two concurrent role-demotion requests from a space admin or workspace owner can each pass the last-admin or last-owner count check before either update is committed because the validation and role update are not serialized in one transaction. The requests can therefore demote the final two space admins or workspace owners and leave the affected space without an admin or the workspace without an owner, preventing normal administrative recovery. This issue is fixed in version 0.96.0.

title: CVE-2026-126828 — A vulnerability in Phison SSD controller firmwares (Phison E18; EIFM80
summary: A vulnerability in Phison SSD controller firmwares (Phison E18; EIFM80.0, Phison E18; EIFK51.2) allows a local attacker with administrative privileges to bypass the "Security Access" handshake by leveraging leaked RSA parameters found in vendor utility binaries. By successfully completing the authentication, an attacker can access vendor-specific commands that permit arbitrary memory read and write operations. Because the firmware's code regions lack protection, these primitives can be used to overwrite existing handlers and achieve volatile code execution on the SSD controller.

title: CVE-2026-127219 — WPChat plugin for WordPress before 1
summary: WPChat plugin for WordPress before 1.4.6 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to invoke the admin claim-offer action by reusing the publicly exposed wpchat_frontend nonce without any capability check. Attackers can call SmartSearchManagerService::claimOffer() via POST /wp-json/wpchat/v1/smart-search/claim-offer to register an attacker-controlled email against the site's domain using the site's stored api_token, corrupting the WPChat account and newsletter identity bound to the installation.

title: CVE-2026-129187 — A vulnerability in the Phison SSD controller firmware Phison E16; EGFM13
summary: A vulnerability in the Phison SSD controller firmware Phison E16; EGFM13.2 allows a local attacker with administrative privileges to bypass the "Security Access" handshake by leveraging leaked RSA parameters found in vendor utility binaries. By successfully completing the authentication, an attacker can access vendor-specific commands that permit arbitrary memory read and write operations. Because the firmware's code regions lack protection, these primitives can be used to overwrite existing handlers and achieve volatile code execution on the SSD controller.

title: CVE-2026-129190 — A vulnerability in the Phison SSD controller firmware Phison E12; ECFM32
summary: A vulnerability in the Phison SSD controller firmware Phison E12; ECFM32.2 allows a local attacker with administrative privileges to bypass the "Security Access" handshake by leveraging leaked RSA parameters found in vendor utility binaries. By successfully completing the authentication, an attacker can access vendor-specific commands that permit arbitrary memory read and write operations. Because the firmware's code regions lack protection, these primitives can be used to overwrite existing handlers and achieve volatile code execution on the SSD controller.

title: CVE-2026-130061 — GPAC before 26
summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a double free vulnerability in gf_sg_sfcommand_del() that allows attackers to crash the process via crafted XMT scenes. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT/MP4 file where a Conditional node's SFCommandBuffer references a command freed twice during scene teardown, causing MP4Box to crash.

title: CVE-2026-130062 — GPAC before 26
summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_node_get_tag() that allows attackers to crash the process via crafted XMT connect elements. Attackers can supply an XMT scene file whose connect element has a parent with no node, crashing MP4Box during processing and causing denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-130063 — GPAC before 26
summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to read freed heap memory via discarded nodes left on the parser node stack. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file processed by MP4Box, causing xmt_text_content() to call gf_node_get_tag() on a freed node and crash the process.

title: CVE-2026-130064 — GPAC before 26
summary: GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_sg_command_del() that allows attackers to trigger reads of freed memory through aliased XMT-A SFCommandBuffer command ownership. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file processed by MP4Box, causing commands freed during node destruction to be reaccessed during access unit cleanup, crashing the process.

title: CVE-2026-130065 — msgpack-c through 7
summary: msgpack-c through 7.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in msgpack_vrefbuffer_migrate() in src/vrefbuffer.c that checks capacity against the source array's end pointer. When migrating between vrefbuffers of unequal size, the realloc is skipped and memcpy() writes iovec entries past the destination array, corrupting adjacent heap memory or crashing the application.

title: CVE-2026-130066 — Alinto SOGo before 5
summary: Alinto SOGo before 5.12.13 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in SQLSource contact lookup that allows authenticated users to inject SQL by placing a backslash before a quote in the object name. Attackers can send requests under a SQL-backed address book path on MySQL or MariaDB to perform UNION or boolean-based reads of the user-source table, including password hashes.

title: CVE-2026-130067 — 7-Zip File Manager before 26
summary: 7-Zip File Manager before 26.03 fails to detect archive entry names padded with Unicode space characters, allowing attackers to bypass the deceptive file name warning in CPanel::IsVirus_Message. Attackers can craft archive entries like a PDF name followed by ideographic spaces and .hta to hide the real extension, executing script content via ShellExecuteExW when opened.

title: CVE-2026-130068 — Umbraco CMS 17
summary: Umbraco CMS 17.0.0 before 17.7.1 and 18.0.0 before 18.2.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in Management API document version endpoints that skip per-document ContentPermissionByResource checks. Authenticated back-office users restricted to a start node can list and read document versions outside their tree by GUID, exposing unpublished values and altering prevent-cleanup flags.

title: CVE-2026-130069 — Frappe Framework before 15
summary: Frappe Framework before 15.123.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the frappe.email.email_body.get_email_html method, which lacks role checks. Authenticated users, including portal Website Users, can inject stylesheet link tags into unescaped email templates, causing Premailer to fetch internal or external hosts and return the content.

title: CVE-2026-130070 — Ghost by muneeb141 on the main branch from commit c731cdf through commit 672dfec contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the whitelisted gh
summary: Ghost by muneeb141 on the main branch from commit c731cdf through commit 672dfec contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the whitelisted ghost.api.ghost.convert_to_real_user method that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip OTP verification by setting the client-supplied bypass_otp parameter. Attackers can obtain a ghost session from the guest-accessible create_ghost_session endpoint, then call convert_to_real_user with an arbitrary real_email and bypass_otp=1 to receive OAuth tokens for existing accounts and take them over.

title: CVE-2026-130071 — TridotsTech go1cms master branch through commit 7f68d05 and version-3 branch before commit ead8da3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in
summary: TridotsTech go1cms master branch through commit 7f68d05 and version-3 branch before commit ead8da3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the guest-whitelisted update_doc method that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify any document. Attackers can supply a doctype, name and arbitrary fields that are saved with ignore_permissions=True, altering User records to escalate privileges, take over accounts or tamper with business data.

title: CVE-2026-130072 — Cloud Commander (cloudcmd) before 19
summary: Cloud Commander (cloudcmd) before 19.21.4 contains an authentication bypass and path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to rename files by sending PUT /rename requests handled before authentication middleware. Attackers can supply absolute or ../ paths in the from and to arrays to move any file the Node.js process can access outside the configured root, causing data loss or denial of service.

title: CVE-2026-130073 — CBoard before commit 7bd8180 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to reach admin functions because AdminC
summary: CBoard before commit 7bd8180 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to reach admin functions because AdminController and DashboardController methods bypass AOP role checks. Attackers with no role grants can call deleteUser, deleteRole, getUserList, getAllWidgetList and getAllDatasetList to read query configurations and delete accounts including the administrator.

title: CVE-2026-130074 — free5GC WebConsole through 1
summary: free5GC WebConsole through 1.4.6 contains an authorization flaw in the ChangePasswordInfo handler that allows authenticated tenant users to change other members' passwords. Attackers can send POST /api/change-password with another tenant member's email and a new password, without the current password, to take over that account.

title: CVE-2026-130075 — SplitPro through 2
summary: SplitPro through 2.1.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the addOrEditExpense and addOrEditCurrencyConversion tRPC mutations that allows authenticated users to assign expenses to arbitrary users. Attackers can enumerate sequential user IDs and supply them in participants or paidBy fields to fabricate debts on victims' balances, even in unseen groups.

title: CVE-2026-130076 — crw-server before 0
summary: crw-server before 0.45.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal services by supplying an unvalidated baseUrl to the /v1/scrape endpoint. Attackers can set llmApiKey and request the summary format, making the server POST to loopback or private addresses and use returned warnings as a reachability oracle.

title: CVE-2026-130077 — crw-server before 0
summary: crw-server before 0.45.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal hosts via caller-controlled proxy and proxy_list fields in /v1/scrape. Attackers can supply proxy entries pointing to loopback, private-network or link-local hosts, bypassing page URL checks to open HTTP-proxy or SOCKS connections internally.

title: CVE-2026-130078 — B3log Solo through 4
summary: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in B3Receiver.receiveArticle that allows visitor accounts to modify any article via the POST /apis/symphony/article endpoint. Attackers can supply their username as userB3Key, since OAuth-created visitors receive it as their B3 key, and overwrite any article's title, content and tags.

title: CVE-2026-130079 — B3log Solo through 4
summary: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject script by setting a malicious article title rendered without escaping. Attackers can set titles, including via the B3 sync endpoint, so admin/article-pwd.ftl, skin templates, and js/page.js article lists execute script in visitors' and administrators' browsers.

title: CVE-2026-130080 — B3log Solo through 4
summary: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the console article update API that allows authenticated authors to inject SQL through unvalidated JSON property names. Attackers can send a PUT request to /console/article/ with crafted property names used as UPDATE column names, then read query results back through the updated article.

title: CVE-2026-130081 — B3log Solo through 4
summary: B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain article view passwords by querying the public GET /articles API. The ArticleProcessor.getArticlesByPage handler leaves the articleViewPwd property in JSON responses, letting attackers read passwords for encrypted articles and access their protected content.

title: CVE-2026-130082 — django-tenants 3
summary: django-tenants 3.4.8 before 4.0.1 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in its PostgreSQL backend that allows attackers to inject SQL through unescaped tenant schema names. Attackers who can choose or influence a schema name can supply quote characters that are interpolated into SET search_path and CREATE, DROP or ALTER SCHEMA statements, letting them read other tenants' data or run SQL as the application's database user.

title: CVE-2026-130083 — BookStack before 26
summary: BookStack before 26.09.2 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the ZIP content importer that allows authenticated users with the Import Content permission to exhaust server storage. Attackers can upload a small ZIP whose data.json references one bundled file many times, causing ZipImportRunner::importAttachment() to write a full copy per reference.

title: CVE-2026-130206 — Chyrp Lite (xenocrat/chyrp-lite) contains a missing brute-force protection vulnerability in the main_login() function that allows remote attackers to
summary: Chyrp Lite (xenocrat/chyrp-lite) contains a missing brute-force protection vulnerability in the main_login() function that allows remote attackers to repeatedly submit login attempts against the admin account without any attempt counter, lockout, delay, or CAPTCHA enforcement. Attackers can send unlimited password guesses via POST requests to the login action until a correct credential is found, gaining full administrative control including post publishing, user management, and file uploads.

title: CVE-2026-130290 — In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5
summary: In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI has a heap buffer over-read in a QueueManager DataQueue::addmethod. In particular, the code blindly trusts the message.parameter1 value provided by the client as the size used to fill the data from the queueData heap buffer. An attacker sends a large parameter1 value in an ADD_TO_SESSION_QUEUE or ADD_TO_NAMED_QUEUE message and then retrieves data with a PULL_FROM_SESSION_QUEUE message. (A very large value causes a process crash.)

title: CVE-2026-68934 — code-review-mcp-server automates code review and can post comments directly on GitHub pull requests
summary: code-review-mcp-server automates code review and can post comments directly on GitHub pull requests. Prior to 1.5.3, the getLocalGitDiff, codeReview, createPR, and getPRTemplate MCP tools accept caller-controlled folderPath and baseBranch string parameters that are interpolated into command strings executed by child_process.execSync through /bin/sh. Shell metacharacters, command substitution, or quote-breaking input can therefore execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the host process running the MCP server. This issue is fixed in version 1.5.3.

title: CVE-2026-69154 — The Coder VS Code extension opens Coder workspaces in VS Code with a single click
summary: The Coder VS Code extension opens Coder workspaces in VS Code with a single click. From 0.1.20 until 1.14.6, a malicious repository can provide .vscode/settings.json values for security-sensitive Coder settings because the extension permits workspace and folder scope to override those settings. Values such as coder.headerCommand and coder.tlsCertRefreshCommand are later executed as shell commands, while other affected settings can redirect the Coder CLI binary or download source, inject CLI or SSH flags, replace TLS material, disable TLS verification, or change identity and credential-storage

summary: The Bluetooth Classic SDP client built its outgoing request PDUs with bt_sdp_create_pdu(), which allocates from the sdp_pool net-buf pool with a K_FOREVER timeout and no failure handling, in sdp_client_ss_search(), sdp_client_sa_search() and sdp_client_ssa_search() in subsys/bluetooth/host/classic/sdp.c. summary: The Virtual L2 receive handler virtual_recv() in subsys/net/l2/virtual/virtual.c ends with a fall-through path meant for a virtual interface that has nothing attached below it: it takes net_if_get_device(iface)->api, treats it as a struct virtual_interface_api, and calls api->recv(iface, pkt). title: CVE-2026-93668 — The Bluetooth Classic SDP server in subsys/bluetooth/host/classic/sdp
summary:
The Bluetooth Classic SDP server in subsys/bluetooth/host/classic/sdp.c allocated every response PDU through bt_sdp_create_pdu(), which expands to bt_l2cap_create_pdu() and therefore uses a K_FOREVER timeout. The allocation is made from sdp_pool, a fixed pool holding only CONFIG_BT_MAX_CONN buffers (one in the default configuration) that is shared with the SDP client role. When the pool is empty the call blocks without a bound.

title: CVE-2026-93669 — The ITE IT8xxx2 SHI host-command backend in subsys/mgmt/ec_host_cmd/backends/ec_host_cmd_backend_shi_ite
summary:

title: CVE-2026-93670 — The Synopsys DesignWare I3C controller driver (drivers/i3c/i3c_dw
summary:
The Synopsys DesignWare I3C controller driver (drivers/i3c/i3c_dw.c) tracks free Device Address Table (DAT) slots with get_free_pos(), which signals an exhausted table by returning -1. The helper declared its return type as uint8_t, so the sentinel was truncated to 255, and both consumers (dw_i3c_attach_device() and dw_i3c_i2c_attach_device()) also stored it in a uint8_t before testing if (pos < 0) — a comparison that is never true for an unsigned value. The exhaustion guard was therefore inert in every build.

title: CVE-2026-93671 — The websocket client's HTTP header callback on_header_value() in subsys/net/lib/websocket/websocket
summary:

The referenced bytes live inside the application-supplied receive buffer and are not NUL terminated. When the received value did not match the expected accept key, the pointer was passed directly to a %s conversion in a NET_DBG() call, so the logging code measured the string with strlen() and read on past the end of the header value looking for a terminator.

title: CVE-2026-93672 — bt_att_find_req_by_user_data() in subsys/bluetooth/host/att
summary:
bt_att_find_req_by_user_data() in subsys/bluetooth/host/att.c walks every ATT channel attached to a connection and dereferences chan->req->user_data without checking chan->req. An ATT channel with no client request in flight holds chan->req == NULL — that is its normal idle state, set by att_handle_rsp() when a response resolves the transaction and tested by att_req_send_process() to pick a free channel — so the lookup reads through a NULL pointer as soon as it visits an idle channel. Every other chan->req user in the file already guards the pointer.

title: CVE-2026-93673 — The Zephyr WebSocket client validates the server's handshake response in on_header_value() in subsys/net/lib/websocket/websocket
summary: The Zephyr WebSocket client validates the server's handshake response in on_header_value() in subsys/net/lib/websocket/websocket.c. The comparison was performed as strncmp(at, str, length), where length is the length of the value the server sent rather than the length of the expected value, so the check only asked whether the received value was a prefix of the expected base64(SHA-1(key || GUID)). A server that returned a handful of correct characters passed, and a response carrying an empty Sec-WebSocket-Accept: header caused strncmp() to be called with a count of zero, which returns 0 and set

title: CVE-2026-130320 — In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5
summary: In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI mishandles nameArg and userid bounds checking, possibly leading to arbitrary code execution via crafted messages.

title: CVE-2026-130327 — In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5
summary: In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI relies on a world-writable /tmp file unless XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is set, or localhost TCP port 10010, allowing RXAPI communication by any local user, e.g., for injection of a macro that will be executed by a REXX script.

title: CVE-2026-130335 — Info-ZIP Zip 3
summary: Info-ZIP Zip 3.0 (and 3.1 beta through 3.1c) allows OS command injection by an attacker who controls the command line. The victim must use the -T option followed by a filename containing shell metacharacters, on a platform (such as Linux) where a suitable shell is run. This occurs because the system C library function is used. NOTE: there is no known common scenario in which an untrusted filename reaches a zip -T call.

title: CVE-2026-12487 — An incorrect authorization vulnerability in the SNMP parameter of Zyxel EE5301-00 customized firmware version 5
summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in the SNMP parameter of Zyxel EE5301-00 customized firmware version 5.63(ACLD.2)b3_D0 could allow an unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition on an affected device.

title: CVE-2026-130338 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored sql injection vulnerability in the MySQL driver that allows database users with table creation rights to inject SQL through unescaped geometry column names in unconvert_field(). Attackers can craft a column name containing an SQL expression that executes with another AdminNeo user's privileges when they edit a row, save it, or export the table.

title: CVE-2026-130339 — phpMyFAQ before 4
summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to read unpublished FAQ titles via bookmark_action. Attackers can request FAQ detail pages with bookmark_action=add across sequential ids, then view /user/bookmarks to reveal draft and pending submission question text.

title: CVE-2026-130340 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows database users to inject markup into another user's session via column type names rendered with innerHTML. Attackers can create a PostgreSQL type or table with markup in its name to render live elements in the help popup, enabling content spoofing and requests to attacker servers.

title: CVE-2026-130341 — phpMyFAQ before 4
summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to inject javascript: links via FAQ comments. When the comment editor is enabled, Utils::parseUrl() strips https:// from sanitized hrefs, turning an allowed https://javascript:443/ link into executable script that runs on the shared admin origin when clicked.

title: CVE-2026-130342 — phpMyFAQ before 4
summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an improper reference counting flaw on multisite deployments, allowing editors to delete other instances' attachment files. Because linkedRecords() counts only the local faqattachment table, deleting an attachment with shared md5 content makes File::delete() unlink the shared blob, destroying another instance's files.

title: CVE-2026-130343 — phpMyFAQ 3
summary: phpMyFAQ 3.2.5 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the user/request-removal API endpoint that lets authenticated users file account removal requests as other users. The ownership check calls getUserById() with the attacker-supplied userId on the session user object, so it compares the input against the target's own record. Attackers who know a victim's login name and email can submit that userId, loginname, and email, sending administrators a spoofed Remove User Request email. This may lead an admin to delete the victim's account an

title: CVE-2026-130344 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Admin::printTablePartitions() that allows authenticated users to inject HTML by placing markup in partition column names. Attackers with CREATE or ALTER privileges can create a partitioned table whose unescaped partition expression executes script when another user opens the table-structure page.

title: CVE-2026-130345 — phpMyFAQ 4
summary: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated frontend users to receive restricted FAQ titles by subscribing to Web Push notifications. When editors publish user/group-restricted FAQs, WebPushService::sendToAll() delivers the question, FAQ id, category, and slugified URL to every subscriber, bypassing the FAQ ACL.

title: CVE-2026-130346 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an sql injection vulnerability in the ClickHouse driver because idf_escape() doubles backticks but does not escape backslashes in identifiers. Attackers can lure a logged-in user into opening a GET link with a column name ending in a backslash in columns, where, or order parameters, causing query text to be parsed as SQL.

title: CVE-2026-130347 — phpMyFAQ before 4
summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authentication bypass in password reset, letting external-identity accounts receive local passwords. Attackers with mailbox access can request reset tokens for OIDC, Keycloak, Entra ID, LDAP, SSO, or WebAuthn accounts and log in locally, skipping IdP MFA and deprovisioning.

title: CVE-2026-130348 — phpMyFAQ 4
summary: phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that exposes restricted and inactive category metadata to unauthenticated visitors. Attackers can enumerate category IDs via /category/{id}/{slug}.html or query /api/v4.0/categories to read names, descriptions, images and FAQ counts of restricted categories.

title: CVE-2026-130349 — phpMyFAQ from 4
summary: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows category- or language-restricted editors to bypass scoped rights via public REST write endpoints. Attackers with a scoped right and the shared API token can use PUT faq/update, POST faq/create, and POST category to rewrite published FAQs and create root categories outside their scope.

title: CVE-2026-130350 — phpMyFAQ before 4
summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows delegated group or user admins to remove rights they do not hold by submitting empty rights lists. Attackers can send an empty rightIds or userRights array to group/permissions or user/update-rights to wipe all rights of more-privileged groups or administrators.

title: CVE-2026-130351 — phpMyFAQ from 4
summary: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the multisite Redis configuration store that is not tenant-scoped. As a result, tenant administrators can read and overwrite the master instance's effective configuration. Attackers can save configuration through /admin/api/configuration, optionally resetting storage.redisPrefix, to redirect master SMTP, set a known API token, or alter authentication settings.

title: CVE-2026-130352 — phpMyFAQ before 4
summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read editor-only Private Notes by querying the public FAQ list API. Attackers can page through GET /api/v4.0/faqs or /api/v3.1/faqs without credentials to retrieve the notes field of every anonymously readable FAQ, exposing internal remarks and ticket details.

title: CVE-2026-130353 — phpMyFAQ before 4
summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in its public FAQ REST API that exposes author names and e-mail addresses to unauthenticated callers. Attackers can query the faq and paginated faqs endpoints to bulk-harvest e-mails and de-anonymise users who opted out of GDPR author visibility.

title: CVE-2026-130354 — phpMyFAQ 4
summary: phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in POST /api/webauthn/prepare that creates accounts as active, bypassing manual activation and domain whitelisting. Anonymous attackers can obtain the freely issued CSRF token and register an activated account with an unverified email to access registered-user-only content and functions.

title: CVE-2026-130355 — phpMyFAQ from 4
summary: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in POST /admin/api/faq/import that lets FAQ_ADD users bypass the FAQ_PUBLISH right. Authenticated contributors can upload a CSV with column 8 set to true to publish unreviewed, optionally sticky FAQs such as phishing content.

title: CVE-2026-130356 — phpMyFAQ from 4
summary: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass that lets category- or language-restricted editors rewrite visibility ACLs and tags of any FAQ. Attackers send faq/update requests with a target faqId and an untranslated lang to expose restricted FAQs, wipe tags, or overwrite orphaned FAQs.

title: CVE-2026-130357 — phpMyFAQ from 4
summary: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in updateUserRights that lets USER_EDIT admins drop category restrictions on group rights. Attackers can re-save rights through the user update-rights API to convert category-restricted group rights into global direct rights, then edit, publish or delete FAQs in withheld categories.

title: CVE-2026-130358 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the ClaudeSqlPlugin, GeminiSqlPlugin, and OpenWebUiPlugin sendHeaders() handlers that run on the login page. Unauthenticated attackers can POST claude, gemini, or openwebui fields to relay arbitrary prompts using the operator's API key or bearer token, including to internal Open WebUI endpoints.

title: CVE-2026-130359 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in SlugifyEditPlugin::getFieldInput() that embeds column names unescaped in an inline initSlugField() call. Attackers with DDL privileges can create a slug column whose name contains a single quote, injecting JavaScript that runs under the page's CSP nonce when victims open the table's edit form.

title: CVE-2026-130360 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in EditorNeo that allows remote attackers to execute JavaScript by injecting quote characters into the request URI. Attackers can lure authenticated users to crafted edit links whose path breaks out of the CSP-nonced whisper script in editor/core/Admin.php, enabling session theft and database credential disclosure.

title: CVE-2026-130361 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a parameter injection vulnerability in its ClickHouse driver that allows attackers to inject ClickHouse HTTP query parameters through an unencoded db GET parameter. Attackers can lure a logged-in victim into opening a crafted GET link that injects a query parameter, bypassing the POST-only CSRF token. ClickHouse then executes attacker-chosen SQL under the victim's credentials to read, modify, or drop data.

title: CVE-2026-130362 — phpMyFAQ 4
summary: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an account enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to identify valid logins through differing POST /api/webauthn/prepare responses. Attackers can submit wordlists of usernames, reusing one unconsumed CSRF token without rate limiting, to discover administrator logins for password spraying and phishing.

title: CVE-2026-130363 — phpMyFAQ from 4
summary: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that lets scoped editors view out-of-scope draft FAQs because the dashboard and admin search ignore category/language-scoped FAQ_EDIT rights. Authenticated editors can load the unpublished FAQs widget with the lang parameter or query /admin/api/faq/search to leak draft titles, ids, and confirm words in draft bodies.

title: CVE-2026-130364 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a reflected HTML injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject markup by supplying crafted array keys in the where URL parameter. Attackers can trick logged-in users into opening a link whose unescaped keys land in select search form name attributes, enabling meta refresh redirects and content spoofing.

title: CVE-2026-130365 — phpMyFAQ from 4
summary: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows FAQ_EDIT users to bypass SvgSanitizer using namespace-prefixed elements like <x:script>. Attackers can upload malicious SVGs through the admin image upload so script runs in the site origin on IIS, hijacking sessions of users like super-admins.

title: CVE-2026-130366 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the ClickHouse driver that allows remote attackers to log in to passwordless accounts without the configured defaultPasswordHash password. Attackers who know the name of a ClickHouse no_password account can submit any non-empty password, because connect() skips openPasswordless(), and obtain a session with that account's rights.

title: CVE-2026-130367 — phpMyFAQ through 4
summary: phpMyFAQ through 4.1.12 and from 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the admin FAQ copy and translate pages, which check only global FAQ_ADD or FAQ_TRANSLATE rights. Authenticated add-only or category-scoped editors can open any FAQ to read drafts, ACL-restricted records, private notes, and author e-mail addresses.

title: CVE-2026-130368 — phpMyFAQ 4
summary: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts vulnerability in PasswordChangeController::update() that bypasses the step-up throttle. Attackers holding a hijacked admin-area session can repeatedly guess faqpassword_old with a reusable CSRF token to learn the original password and take over the account.

title: CVE-2026-130369 — phpMyFAQ 4
summary: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in multisite deployments that allows attackers to overwrite passkeys of accounts on other tenants via a shared PHP session store. Attackers can run WebAuthn prepare() for a login on one tenant, then replay the session against /api/webauthn/register on another tenant or the master to replace that user's passkeys and log in as admin.

title: CVE-2026-130370 — phpMyFAQ 4
summary: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows attackers holding a hijacked session to enroll passkeys using only the session and webauthn CSRF token. Attackers can call /api/webauthn/prepare and /api/webauthn/register to replace the owner's passkeys, gaining persistent passwordless login that survives password changes and resets.

title: CVE-2026-130371 — phpMyFAQ before 4
summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability because the web installer ignores the legacy config/database.php during 3.x upgrades. Unauthenticated attackers can reinstall the site against an attacker-controlled database and create their own administrator account to take over the application.

title: CVE-2026-130372 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect authenticated users by injecting an external URL through the HTTP Referer header into the hidden referer field of the edit form. Attackers can lure users from a page with an unsafe-url referrer policy whose URL contains &select=, redirecting them to phishing sites after record edits.

title: CVE-2026-130373 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows database users to inject markup by creating FULLTEXT indexes with crafted names. Attackers with CREATE, ALTER or INDEX rights can store markup rendered unescaped in the selection search form, enabling meta refresh redirects, content spoofing and form tampering against other users.

title: CVE-2026-130374 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject SQL by supplying crafted IN and NOT IN search values that process_length() passes unescaped. Attackers can send a logged-in user a cross-site GET link using a backslash-escaped apostrophe to run blind SQL with that user's database rights on PostgreSQL, SQLite, MS SQL, Oracle, or MySQL in NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES mode.

title: CVE-2026-130375 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows authenticated SQLite users to bypass the check_sqlite_name() extension guard using PDO_SQLite file: URI database names. Attackers can select the PDO driver with ext=pdo and submit names like file:/webroot/x.php?x=.db to create a .php file, then store PHP source as table data for code execution.

title: CVE-2026-130376 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in FileUploadPlugin that allows database users to store script-bearing SVG files by uploading unsanitized content. Attackers can upload a malicious SVG to a *_path field, executing script in the same-origin session of any administrator who opens the file link.

title: CVE-2026-130377 — phpMyFAQ from 4
summary: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in DELETE /admin/api/faq/delete that lets language-scoped FAQ_DELETE admins bypass their language scope. Attackers can submit a faqId with an in-scope faqLanguage lacking a translation to wipe shared ACL, tags, votes, comments, and attachments of other translations.

title: CVE-2026-130378 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a filter injection vulnerability in its MongoDB driver that allows attackers to affect other documents by embedding ' AND ' or ') OR (' delimiters in a string _id or searched value. Attackers who can store a crafted document can cause a victim's delete or edit to match unintended documents, deleting the entire collection or modifying another document.

title: CVE-2026-130379 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass the privileged-port restriction by injecting separator characters or connection-string keywords into the login server field. Attackers can make pgsql, Mongo, Oracle and PDO drivers parse a different host and port, reaching internal services and leaking limited information through driver responses and errors.

title: CVE-2026-130380 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the sqlsrv-based MS SQL driver that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in by submitting an empty username. Attackers can supply any non-empty password, triggering Windows integrated authentication that grants a full session with the web server identity's SQL Server privileges.

title: CVE-2026-130381 — phpMyFAQ from 4
summary: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows language-scoped editors to read other translations by checking FAQ_EDIT against the route language but loading the ?lang= UI-language row. Attackers can request the admin.faq.edit route with an authorized language and a different lang parameter to read drafts, private notes, author e-mails and revisions.

title: CVE-2026-130382 — AdminNeo before 5
summary: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in OtpLoginPlugin that allows attackers knowing the database password to skip TOTP verification by abusing the permanent-login cookie. Attackers can submit a login with a wrong OTP and permanent=1 to obtain a neo_permanent cookie, then replay it to gain full authenticated database access.

title: CVE-2026-130383 — phpMyFAQ before 4
summary: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated editors to manipulate search index documents by supplying an arbitrary solutionId to the /admin/api/faq/update endpoint. On Elasticsearch or OpenSearch deployments, category-restricted editors can remove published FAQs from search, overwrite other FAQs' search documents, or plant entries that remain searchable after unpublishing.

title: CVE-2026-79614 — An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in “libclinkc
summary: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in “libclinkc.so” in Zyxel DX3301-T0/EX3301-T0 firmware versions through 5.50(ABVY.8.3)C0 could allow an unauthenticated attacker to elevate privileges and potentially execute arbitrary commands by sending a crafted HTTP request. WAN access is disabled by default on these devices.

title: CVE-2026-86676 — A post-authentication command injection vulnerability in the “Description” parameter of a CGI program in Zyxel DX3300-T0 firmware versions through 5
summary: A post-authentication command injection vulnerability in the “Description” parameter of a CGI program  in Zyxel DX3300-T0 firmware versions through 5.50(ABVY.8.3)C0 could allow an authenticated attacker with administrator privileges to execute OS commands by sending a crafted HTTP request.

title: Kẻ lừa đảo gặp chiêu bài đảo chiều: Bị hàng trăm nghìn bot AI “giả ngu” giăng bẫy ngược
summary: Một công ty tại Úc đang dùng hàng trăm nghìn bot AI giả làm những người có thể mắc bẫy lừa đảo. Trong lúc đối phương tìm cách thuyết phục “nạn nhân” chuyển tiền, các bot âm thầm câu giờ và thu thập thông tin về hoạt động gian lận.

after teardown has flushed it. The work is also enabled before late

with work still queued.

Attackers can send requests with a forged viewToken cookie, which is never validated as a JWT, to read all pages and assets of RequireAuth documentation sites.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129547 — Kalmia đến 0

title: CVE-2026-129548 — Kalmia through 0
summary: Kalmia through 0.2.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows read-only authenticated users to upload HTML or SVG files via the upload-file endpoint without type restrictions. Attackers can share links to files served unauthenticated through the file get route, executing JavaScript in the admin origin to steal administrator JWTs from localStorage.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129548 — Kalmia đến 0

title: CVE-2026-129549 — Tensei through 0
summary: Tensei through 0.11.5 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the @tensei/media plugin that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload dangerous file types via the files/upload route. Attackers can set the multipart Content-Type to upload HTML or SVG files served from the application origin, causing stored cross-site scripting and storage consumption.

title: CVE-2026-129550 — Tensei through 0
summary: Tensei through 0.11.5 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in @tensei/auth that allows unauthenticated or authenticated users to assign themselves arbitrary roles via the exposed User Roles field. Attackers can supply a roles array during registration, a POST to the users route, or a PATCH to their own record to gain administrator permissions.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129550 — Tensei đến 0

title: CVE-2026-129551 — Tensei through 0
summary: Tensei through 0.11.5 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in parseSortFromStringToObject of @tensei/rest that allows unauthenticated attackers to set Object.prototype properties via the sort parameter. Attackers can send a sort value like __proto__.<name>:<value> to list, fetch-one, update or delete routes before authorization, altering application logic and causing denial of service.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129551 — Tensei đến 0

title: CVE-2026-129552 — Tensei through 0
summary: Tensei through 0.11.5 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in @tensei/auth that falls back to the hard-coded JWT signing key 'auth-secret-key' when JWT_SECRET is unset. Unauthenticated attackers can sign tokens with arbitrary user ids accepted by populateContextFromToken to impersonate any user, including administrators.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129552 — Tensei đến 0

title: CVE-2026-129553 — Tensei through 0
summary: Tensei through 0.11.5 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the @tensei/social-auth SocialAuthCallbackController that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users by supplying an unvalidated clientCallback query parameter. Attackers can craft links to the /:provider/callback route that send victims to attacker-controlled sites for phishing and leak the issued temporary access token appended after login.
title_vi: CVE-2026-129553 — Tensei đến 0

When a client completes an upload and then disconnects before the handler writes the reply, for example while the handler scans, hashes or forwards the file, the response only emits a close event, the cleanup hook never runs, and the saved files are left on disk. An unauthenticated client can repeat this cheaply to exhaust disk space

title: CVE-2026-111559 — Batflat CMS does not sanitize data passed to the /contact endpoint
summary:
Batflat CMS does not sanitize data passed to the /contact endpoint. A remote unauthenticated attacker can send a POST request with a crafted message, causing arbitrary PHP code execution with www-data user privileges.


The project is no longer maintained and the issue has not been fixed.

title: CVE-2026-113443 — visualTicket is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in the cart service
summary: visualTicket is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference  in the cart service. The server modifies or deletes a cart item based solely on the supplied "cart_id" without checking whether the object belongs to the current symfony session. Cart identifiers are created sequentially and allows prediction of valid values. An attacker holding an independent session can reference another user's "cart_id" and change its state, for example altering the quantity or deleting the item.  This allows modification or deletion of items in another user's cart, alteration of the cart total, and disruption

title: CVE-2026-113444 — visualTicket is vulnerable to Path Traversal in the thumbnail generation mechanism
summary:
visualTicket is vulnerable to Path Traversal in the thumbnail generation mechanism. The file parameter is used directly when constructing the output filesystem path without restriction to the uploads directory, allowing a remote attacker to use ../ sequences to escape /uploads/user_temp_images/ and write the generated JPEG file to other writable locations, including the web root. This allows unauthorized creation of JPEG files outside the intended uploads directory, leading to file-space pollution and potential overwriting of predictable resources with matching names.




This issue was fixed

title: CVE-2026-113445 — visualTicket is vulnerable to information exposure through an error message in the order creation functionality
summary:
visualTicket is vulnerable to information exposure through an error message in the order creation functionality. Because detailed data-layer exceptions are returned to the client instead of being logged server-side only, a remote unauthenticated attacker can submit a valid checkout request with an invalid payment_type value, causing the application to return a detailed SQL/ORM error that discloses the database name, table and column names, query structure, and foreign key constraint name.




This issue was fixed in version 20260817.

title: CVE-2026-113446 — visualTicket is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the "culture" and "sf_culture" parameters
summary:
visualTicket is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the "culture" and "sf_culture" parameters. An attacker can prepare a specially crafted URL that, when opened, results in arbitrary JavaScript execution in the error page in the victim's browser.




This issue was fixed in version 20260817.

title: CVE-2026-113447 — visualTicket is vulnerable to Session Fixation via the symfony session identifier passed in the URL
summary:
visualTicket is vulnerable to Session Fixation via the symfony session identifier passed in the URL. The application accepts the symfony session ID from the query string and set it as a session cookie in the HTTP response, allowing the browser's active session to be overwritten. This behaviour enables an attacker to fix a session ID for a victim and later hijack the authenticated session.




This issue was fixed in version 20260817.

title: CVE-2026-113448 — visualTicket is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting in logon functionality
summary:
visualTicket is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting in logon functionality. An attacker can prepare a specially crafted URL that, when opened, results in arbitrary JavaScript execution in the victim's browser.




This issue was fixed in version 20260817.

title: CVE-2026-113449 — visualTicket is vulnerable to information exposure through JSONP on session-bound cart service endpoints
summary:
visualTicket is vulnerable to information exposure through JSONP on session-bound cart service endpoints. Session-bound data (including the session id, cart id, item ids, ticket/event metadata, quantities and prices) is returned inside a script wrapper, and since the symfony session token can also be passed in the URL, a remote attacker who obtains the token can read the cart session token and cart data.




This issue was mitigated in version 20260817: the session cookie is set with SameSite=Lax, which prevents other websites from reading cart data of the victim’s session.

title: CVE-2026-113450 — visualTicket is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the JSONP callback parameter
summary:
visualTicket is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the JSONP callback parameter. An attacker can prepare a specially crafted URL that, when opened, results in arbitrary JavaScript execution in the victim's browser.




This issue was fixed in version 20260817.

title: CVE-2026-113451 — visualTicket is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) across multiple endpoints
summary:
visualTicket is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) across multiple endpoints. State-changing operations are exposed via GET requests without any CSRF protection. A remote attacker can persuade an authenticated user (including administrator) into navigating to a prepared URL, causing the victim's browser to issue requests that carry the active session cookie and perform unintended actions.




This issue was partially addressed in version 20260817: settings changes and bulk refunds require POST with a CSRF token, and the session cookie is set with SameSite=Lax, which limits cross-s

title: CVE-2026-113452 — visualTicket is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the selectedDate parameter in the order summary page
summary:
visualTicket is vulnerable to  Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the selectedDate parameter in the order summary page. An attacker can prepare a specially crafted URL that, when opened, results in arbitrary JavaScript execution in the victim's browser.




This issue was fixed in version 20260817.

title: CVE-2026-113453 — visualTicket does not require authentication for the PDF invoice file serving functionality
summary:
visualTicket does not require authentication for the PDF invoice file serving functionality. Invoice PDF files reside in a web-accessible static path without a session check, while authorization is enforced only at the invoice registry page. A remote unauthenticated attacker who obtains the URL of an invoice PDF can download the document without authorization.




This issue was fixed in version 20260817.

title: CVE-2026-113454 — visualTicket exposes sensitive information in error messages in the administrative report generator
summary:
visualTicket exposes sensitive information in error messages in the administrative report generator. Because application exception details and SQL queries are rendered in the HTTP response in the production environment, an authenticated administrator submitting an invalid date_from value in the report request receives a detailed error page disclosing the full SELECT statement, table and column names, JOINs, bind parameters, and a PHP DateTime exception.




This issue was fixed in version 20260817.

title: CVE-2026-113455 — visualTicket displays secret token value in admin settings panel
summary:
visualTicket displays secret token value in admin settings panel. The "KSeF - Token API" edit form renders a pre-filled field containing the actual KSeF API integration secret without any masking.




This issue was fixed in version 20260817.

title: CVE-2026-113456 — visualTicket exposes sensitive information in error messages in the cinema report generator
summary:
visualTicket exposes sensitive information in error messages in the cinema report generator. An authenticated attacker with an admin privileges can supply an invalid date_from value causing the application to return a detailed error page that discloses the full SELECT statement (table and column names, JOIN, GROUP BY and ORDER BY clauses, bind parameter placeholders) and a PHP DateTime parsing exception.




This issue was fixed in version 20260817.
