title: CVE-2026-124002 — XWEB EVO versions 5
summary: XWEB EVO versions 5.2.3 through before 5.7.0 contains a pre-authentication OS command injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands by injecting shell metacharacters into the username field of login.lua, cleanout.lua, or api.lua before the password check occurs. Attackers can exploit this flaw combined with the setuid-root wlua interpreter to execute commands with root privileges, achieving full system compromise. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

title: CVE-2026-124003 — XWEB EVO before 5
summary: XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 contains a command injection vulnerability where the setuid-root Lua CGI interpreter wlua executes system("/usr/bin/lua "+argv) on unsanitized input. Attackers can craft malicious input reached through a .lua CGI endpoint to inject arbitrary commands into the concatenated argv string, achieving command execution with root privileges. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

title: CVE-2026-124004 — XWEB EVO before 5
summary: XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 contains a hardcoded backdoor password vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain full administrative access to the built-in Administrator account. Attackers can authenticate using the hardcoded credential xwebevonewgeneration in a single request to obtain a complete admin session and full control over the application. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

title: CVE-2026-124005 — XWEB EVO 4
summary: XWEB EVO 4.3.0 through 5.8.8 contains a weak password generation vulnerability that allows remote attackers to derive the Administrator code-of-the-day password using only the device MAC address and date, with no server secret involved. Attackers can analyze the firmware binary xwpasswd, which itself functions as the password generator, to compute valid Administrator credentials offline and authenticate to the device without authorization. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

title: CVE-2026-124006 — XWEB EVO through 5
summary: XWEB EVO through 5.8.8 contains a predictable credential generation vulnerability that allows attackers to derive the Linux root password by computing a fixed prefix combined with a daily password value. Attackers can calculate the deterministic root credential, which before 5.7.0 was identical across all units and from 5.7.0 onward remains derivable from the MAC-based daily password, to gain unauthorized root access to the underlying operating system. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

title: CVE-2026-124007 — XWEB EVO before 5
summary: XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 contains a pre-authentication OS command injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands by injecting shell metacharacters into the password field. Attackers can exploit the unescaped interpolation of the password value into the hashpass invocation within login.lua, cleanout.lua, and api.lua to achieve root-level command execution via the setuid wlua interpreter. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

title: CVE-2026-124008 — XWEB EVO 5
summary: XWEB EVO 5.2.3 through 5.8.8 contains an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability in the devices.lua template handling, which allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands by injecting unescaped template source into unzip and related shell commands. Attackers can exploit this flaw through the wlua interpreter to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the affected device. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

title: CVE-2026-124009 — XWEB EVO 5
summary: XWEB EVO 5.2.3 through 5.8.8 contains an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root by injecting shell metacharacters into the output device path parameter processed by backup.lua. Attackers can exploit the unescaped concatenation into mount, unzip, and related shell commands run via the wlua interpreter, including through the setuid xwbackup.cgi and xwrestore.cgi interfaces, to achieve full system compromise. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

title: CVE-2026-124010 — XWEB EVO before 5
summary: XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root by exploiting the setuid-root CGI xwconsole.cgi. Attackers can supply malicious input through the sh parameter, which is passed unsanitized to popen(), to achieve full system compromise. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

title: CVE-2026-124011 — XWEB EVO 5
summary: XWEB EVO 5.6.2 through 5.8.8 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain the device's eth0 MAC address and system clock by accessing sysinfo.lua, which also feeds the pre-login page. Attackers can use the disclosed MAC address and system clock values to offline derive the MAC-based daily password, enabling unauthorized authentication to the device. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

title: CVE-2026-124012 — XWEB EVO 5
summary: XWEB EVO 5.6.2 through 5.8.8 contains a hardcoded credential vulnerability where the Administrator web account is configured to use password_mode daily_password with no stored password, as the Users.authenticate function in lualib_users.lua synthesizes the Administrator configuration without validating any stored secret. Attackers who can derive the MAC-based daily password can authenticate as Administrator to obtain a full admin session on the device. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

title: CVE-2026-124013 — XWEB EVO 5
summary: XWEB EVO 5.6.2 through 5.8.8 contains an authenticated OS command injection vulnerability in the api.lua import_preconfiguration and restore actions, where server_url and related server credential fields are concatenated unescaped into a root curl command executed via io.popen. Attackers can inject malicious shell commands through these unfiltered parameters to achieve arbitrary command execution with root privileges on the underlying system. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

title: CVE-2026-124014 — XWEB EVO 4
summary: XWEB EVO 4.3.0 through 5.8.8 contains an unauthenticated arbitrary file write vulnerability that allows remote attackers to modify the system configuration file /etc/xwebconfig.json by sending a crafted POST request to config.lua with action=set, which performs no session validation and writes the raw, unvalidated request body. Attackers can tamper with configuration values such as model and plugin fields or trigger a SYSTEM_NOT_CONFIGURED state via the unauthenticated action=get and action=set operations, resulting in configuration tampering and denial of service. title: CVE-2026-124015 — XWEB EVO 5
summary: XWEB EVO 5.6.2 through 5.8.8 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to set the password of any account flagged must-reset-at-next-login by exploiting missing session validation in the users.lua update_password action. Attackers can reset the password of newly onboarded operator accounts, clearing the password_expiration flag and gaining an immediately usable authenticated foothold on the system. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

title: CVE-2026-127120 — A vulnerability was found in Governikus AusweisApp Mobile up to 2
summary: A vulnerability was found in Governikus AusweisApp Mobile up to 2.5.5. This impacts an unknown function of the component StartPAOSResponse Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument ResultMessage results in cross site scripting. The attack can be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 2.6.0 will fix this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised. This CVE was requested by the vendor.

summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. From versions 1.4.0 to before 1.4.4, and 1.5.0 to before 1.5.1, an uninitialized value use vulnerability in bacnet-stack's AtomicReadFile record-access ACK encoder allows unauthenticated remote attackers to corrupt the encoded OCTET STRING length and payload boundary in network responses by sending a crafted AtomicReadFile request that reaches a successful record-access path. This issue has been patched in versions 1.4.4 and 1.5.1.

summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. summary: BACnet Stack is a BACnet open source protocol stack C library for embedded systems. summary:
An untrusted search path issue in Aurora PostgreSQL dialect detection in the AWS Advanced Go Wrapper from release 2026-04-06 (awssql/v2.0.0) and before release 2026-07-29 (awssql/v2.0.3) could allow a remote authenticated user to escalate privileges to those of another database user, including a member of the rds_superuser role, via a crafted function that runs when that user connects to an Aurora PostgreSQL cluster through an affected version of the wrapper.

title: CVE-2026-126673 — Data::Dump::Streamer versions before 3
summary:
Data::Dump::Streamer versions before 3.00 for Perl allow code injection via unescaped Regexp patterns in _dump_qr.

A Regexp's pattern is written into a qr literal without escaping "$" or "@", so "@{[ ... ]}" and "${\ ... }" in the pattern run as code when the dump is evaluated. An already escaped delimiter gets a second backslash, which leaves the delimiter bare and ends the qr literal early.

An attacker who supplies a pattern that an application compiles, dumps and later restores with eval or do can run arbitrary Perl code.

There was no CA-chain validation, no issuer/subject allowlist, and no pinning. title: CVE-2026-119233 — proxygen's HTTP/3 codec buffered an incomplete non-DATA frame, such as a control-stream frame, a frame of an unknown or reserved type, or a HEADERS fr
summary: proxygen's HTTP/3 codec buffered an incomplete non-DATA frame, such as a control-stream frame, a frame of an unknown or reserved type, or a HEADERS frame, until its entire declared length had arrived, without limiting that length, and re-scanned all buffered data each time more bytes arrived. A remote, unauthenticated HTTP/3 peer could declare a very large frame and deliver it slowly, causing unbounded memory growth and CPU usage that grows quadratically with the number of fragments, leading to denial of service. This issue affects proxygen versions prior to v2026.11.09.00.

title: CVE-2026-119234 — mvfst did not adequately merge or compact out-of-order STREAM frame data, and a small received fragment could keep a much larger receive buffer alive
summary: mvfst did not adequately merge or compact out-of-order STREAM frame data, and a small received fragment could keep a much larger receive buffer alive. QUIC flow control limits the number of buffered stream bytes, but not this per-fragment memory and bookkeeping. A remote, unauthenticated QUIC peer could send many small, non-contiguous stream fragments to make an endpoint consume memory far in excess of its advertised receive window and spend increasing CPU time reassembling stream data, leading to denial of service. This issue affects mvfst versions prior to v2026.11.09.0.

An attacker who can influence an axis field name can cause JavaScript to execute when a user views the rendered chip. The field name can be interpreted as HTML in both attribute and element contexts. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. The first affected release has not been established.

Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality and integrity of data available in the user's browser context. The first affected release has not been established.

title: CVE-2026-117373 — Janus WebRTC Server 1
summary: Janus WebRTC Server 1.2.3 through 1.4.0 is vulnerable to Directory Traversal. The application accepts a caller supplied media path when an ondemand stream is created. The path is validated only by checking whether it contains one of the audio extensions and is then passed to the file source which opens it. No canonicalization is performed and no directory allowlist is enforced, so an unauthenticated caller can make the server open an arbitrary local file and use it as a media source, with the content delivered to viewers as RTP audio.
title_vi: CVE-2026-117373 — Máy chủ Janus WebRTC 1

title: CVE-2026-68485 — An authorization bypass in website-index
summary: An authorization bypass in website-index.php in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an authenticated manager restricted to one agency to view another agency's website listing by changing the agencyid request parameter. summary: An authorization bypass in campaign-zone linking in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an authenticated manager, or a trafficker with zone-linking permissions, to associate another agency's campaign with their own zone. Campaign ownership checks are missing from the bulk-linking and single-link operations in zone-include.php and the XML-RPC campaign-linking method. title: CVE-2026-77168 — A cross-site request forgery vulnerability in tracker-invocation
summary: A cross-site request forgery vulnerability in tracker-invocation.php in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an attacker to modify a tracker's name, description or advertiser assignment using an authenticated victim's permissions. A leftover state-changing handler accepts request parameters without verifying a CSRF token, although it is not used by the normal invocation-tag interface. Exploitation requires victim interaction and a request path that carries the victim's session credentials. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by removing the unused tracker-modification handler.

summary: An authorization bypass in channel-edit.php in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an authenticated manager to create a delivery rule set belonging to another agency by changing the submitted agencyid parameter. The server trusts the submitted agency identifier when inserting the new rule set, allowing unauthorized creation of objects in another agency's account. The issue is fixed in Revive Adserver 6.0.9 by obtaining the agency identifier from the authenticated account rather than submitted form data and removing the agency identifier from the form's hidden fields.

title: CVE-2026-126769 — OpsTree REMS through 1

title: CVE-2026-91151 — A flaw was found in Cockpit
summary: A flaw was found in Cockpit. A local authenticated user with control over a target account's home directory can exploit a privileged symlink dereference vulnerability in the `ssh-add-public-key.sh` helper. When this helper runs with elevated privileges, it can be tricked into following attacker-controlled symlinks within the `.ssh` or `authorized_keys` paths. This allows the attacker to arbitrarily change file ownership and modes, potentially leading to local privilege escalation and impacting the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of the system.

title: CVE-2026-100307 — Missing authorization in the external management API in Amazon mcp-gateway-registry 1
summary:
Missing authorization in the external management API in Amazon mcp-gateway-registry 1.0.9 through 1.24.7 might allow an authenticated remote user to assign the registry administrator scope to their own identity group and obtain administrative control of every registered gateway asset via a crafted group import request.



To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 1.25.0.

summary:
Server-side request forgery (SSRF) in the server registration and update API in Amazon mcp-gateway-registry before 1.35.0 might allow an authenticated remote user to send requests from the gateway to internal network services and cloud instance metadata endpoints and read the responses via a crafted request.



To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 1.35.0.

title: CVE-2026-126797 — NextScan 1
summary: NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in ns-admin that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens using a hardcoded JWT signing key. Attackers can sign an HS256 X-Access-Token carrying the public super administrator role ID to gain full access to user management, scan tasks and stored vulnerability results.

title: CVE-2026-126798 — NextScan 1
summary: NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the ns-admin URL asset detail dialog that renders crawled form request bodies (Asset_URL.data) via innerHTML without encoding. Attackers can host crafted forms on crawled sites to store JavaScript that executes when users view asset details, stealing localStorage access tokens to hijack sessions, including administrators.

title: CVE-2026-126799 — Gotenberg 8
summary: Gotenberg 8.31.0 before 8.38.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in IsPublicIP() that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass private-IP deny-list protections using IPv6 zone identifiers. Attackers can append a zone such as %25eth0 to the unspecified address or blocked IPv6 prefixes in downloadFrom, webhook, or Chromium/LibreOffice URLs to reach internal services and read responses in the returned PDF.

title: CVE-2026-126800 — Hydro @hydrooj/ui-default before 4
summary: Hydro @hydrooj/ui-default before 4.59.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to inject script by placing double quotes in language- class tokens within markdown-it-xss.ts. Attackers can store a payload in their profile bio that executes when administrators or other users view it, stealing the non-httpOnly sid session cookie for session hijacking.

title: CVE-2026-126801 — Rote 1
summary: Rote 1.2.0 through 2.6.0 contains an authorization bypass in the OAuth bind/merge endpoint that allows authenticated users to merge any OAuth-bound account into their own. Attackers can submit a public existingUserId and GitHub or Apple user ID to take over notes, attachments, and API keys and delete the victim account.

title: CVE-2026-126802 — NextScan 1
summary: NextScan 1.1.0 through 1.2.0 contains hardcoded HTTP Basic Auth credentials in ns-admin's AuthAgent and AuthExternal routers that allow unauthenticated attackers to access protected APIs. Attackers can call /agent/config to obtain Redis passwords, etcd details and the server token, and impersonate scan nodes via registration, heartbeat and logging endpoints.

title: CVE-2026-126803 — Rote through 2
summary: Rote through 2.6.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows authenticated admins to obtain super_admin rights by reading or overwriting JWT signing secrets via /v2/api/admin/settings. Attackers can retrieve the unmasked jwtSecret from the security settings group and forge HS256 tokens for the super administrator to change user roles and escalate their own account.

title: CVE-2026-126804 — WWBN AVideo 12
summary: WWBN AVideo 12.4 through 29.7.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the ADs plugin deleteImage.json.php that allows authenticated users with custom ads to delete arbitrary files. Attackers can set the unvalidated is_regular_user parameter to another user's id or ../ sequences to delete other users' ads or files like videos/configuration.php, taking the site offline and re-exposing the installer.

title: CVE-2026-126805 — WWBN AVideo through 29
summary: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows delegated Videos Admin users to obtain video_id_hash values bound to any video owner via encoder endpoints like aVideoEncoderStatus.json.php. Attackers can request the hash for an administrator-owned video and replay it through useVideoHashOrLogin() for password-less login, gaining plugin upload, configuration, and user management access.

title: CVE-2026-126806 — WWBN AVideo 14
summary: WWBN AVideo 14.3 through 29.7.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows uploaders to inject scripts via the videoDownloadedLink value stored unescaped through objects/aVideoEncoder.json.php. Attackers can embed event-handler payloads in the URL host rendered as a Source tag in view/managerVideos_body.php, executing in administrator sessions to install plugin archives containing PHP.

title: CVE-2026-126807 — WuzAPI through 1
summary: WuzAPI through 1.1.0 contains a cross-tenant information disclosure vulnerability in the GetHistory handler that allows authenticated users to view other tenants' chat metadata. Attackers with message history enabled can request GET /chat/history with chat_jid=index to list every user's internal ID, stored chat JIDs, and last-message times.

title: CVE-2026-126808 — weDevs ERP (WP ERP) through 1
summary: weDevs ERP (WP ERP) through 1.17.11 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated employees to edit their own HR records because HRM AJAX handlers check erp_edit_employee instead of erp_manage_jobinfo. Attackers can post their own user_id with the My Profile nonce to change designation, reporting manager, pay rate, and employment type, or delete job history.

title: CVE-2026-126809 — WWBN AVideo through 29
summary: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in objects/import.json.php that allows uploaders to import other users' MP4 files by referencing any folder under videos/. Attackers can copy private, unlisted, password-protected or pay-per-view videos, read victims' .txt/.html sidecars as descriptions, list files via objects/listFiles.json.php, and delete victims' media using the delete parameter.

title: CVE-2026-126810 — WWBN AVideo 29
summary: WWBN AVideo 29.1.0 through 29.7.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows registered users to inject markup through the channel About field rendered in feed/index.php. Attackers can store an unquoted event-handler payload that bypasses feedHtmlDescription() filtering and executes via rss-style.xsl for any visitor, including administrators, viewing the channel feed.

title: CVE-2026-126811 — BookStack before 26
summary: BookStack before 26.09.3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access other users' unpublished draft page images by checking only PageView permission without draft status. Attackers can read drawio data via the base64 endpoint or rename, replace, or delete draft images by sequential ID to disclose or tamper with unpublished work.

title: CVE-2026-126812 — blueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition before 4

Unauthenticated attackers reaching the Docker host on port 3306 can log in as root without a password to read, modify, or delete user accounts, blueprints, and all databases.

title: CVE-2026-126813 — Roundcube Webmail before 1

Attackers can lure logged-in victims into opening crafted GET links to mail/show or mail/get, executing IMAP commands that delete messages, change flags, or grant mailbox access via SETACL.

title: CVE-2026-126814 — blueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition before 4
summary: blueprintUE Self-Hosted Edition before 4.3.6 contains an iframe injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to embed arbitrary third-party content by abusing the PeerTube video URL matcher in BlueprintService::findVideoProvider(). Attackers can set a blueprint video URL on an attacker-controlled host, which site.js loads in an unsandboxed iframe after consent, framing fake login forms or malware downloads.

title: CVE-2026-65957 — Helio is an MCP proxy that sits between AI agents and the tools they use
summary: Helio is an MCP proxy that sits between AI agents and the tools they use. A public DNS name such as 192.168.attacker.com, 10.evil.io, or 172.16.pwn.example also satisfies that prefix, so the proxy echoed the attacker origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin. This issue has been patched in version 0.8.0.
